text:
maya: heads-upuploaded a compact flow for the autoscale confirmation modal in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/COMPACT/autoscale-confirm
liam: nice and tidy. my main concern: the cost line needs clearer timeframe and unit.
sara: copy suggestion: header 'Confirm autoscale change' + primary CTA 'Apply changes' and small helper 'provisions capacity in ~2 minutes'. keeps CTA short.
ethan: accessibility: when modal opens focus must land on the main CTA, use aria-live for the cost/SLO cards, and ensure alerts are announced.
ben: GPU pool selector: show inline pool chips with name + free GPUs + latency tag (low/med/high). clicking a chip picks the pool and shows a small badge if it supports burst.
olivia: mobile: chips should collapse to icon + short label and allow horizontal scroll so modal doesn't grow vertically.
maya: UX question: if min == max, should the burst toggle be disabled? my vote: disable and show a tooltip explaining why.
liam: agree. tooltip copy: 'Burst requires a larger max than min. Increase max to allow short spikes.' actionable and simple.
sara: microcopy: change 'estimated cost impact' -> 'estimated monthly cost change (approx.)' and add an 'assumptions' link that opens a tiny panel listing tokens/hr and seq length.
ethan: perf note: debounce estimate requests on slider changes (250ms) and show a skeleton loader in the summary cards while computing.
ben: also add a guardrail row: if change risks SLO degradation show a yellow warning; if it violates a hard guardrail show red and require extra confirmation.
maya: visual preference: compact summary row at top with 3 mini-cards (cost delta, SLO delta, pool) and an expand arrow for details. keeps modal scannable.
liam: tiny UI nit: ensure primary CTA color doesn't match danger in dark theme. verify across themes.
sara: a11y nit: ensure chips have aria-labels and hit targets >=44px for touch. readable contrast on latency tags.
deploy-bot: uploaded image -> autoscale-confirm-v2.png
olivia: i'll draft the acceptance criteria: estimates updated <200ms average, debounced calls, skeleton shows during compute, disabled burst shows tooltip, chips collapse on mobile.
maya: thanks all 44d. I'll incorporate changes and ping when prototype is in staging
